description: Translates benchmark spec names onto the production names already in the action registry. EXPECTATION-SIDE ONLY: applied when building expected values, never read by the runtime pipeline. Production is not renamed to fit the benchmark.

parameter_values.description: Where production expects a different value shape than the spec wrote. open_url takes a BARE SHORTCUT TOKEN (not a domain, not a full URL): actions/browser.py SITE_SHORTCUTS is keyed on 'youtube', 'google', and ai/intent.py _validate_url returns raw.lower() for those keys. Verified by reading the code, not assumed.

notes.wake_greeting: No production wake-acknowledgement intent exists. 'Hey Asma.', 'Hello Asma.' and 'Hello.' all resolve through the same greeting rule, so commands 1, 2 and 20 expect the same intent and the engine does not distinguish them. Reported, not fixed.
notes.help: 'help' is a META intent handled by ai/planner.py, not a registered action. action.selected is therefore null for it by design, and that is not an ACTION-layer failure.
notes.greeting: Also a meta intent, same as above.
